# orch8 Provider

Manage Orch8 durable-workflow engine resources (sequences, triggers, cron schedules, API keys, queue routing, rollback policies, credentials) through the engine's REST API (`/api/v1`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    orch8 = {
      source = "orch8-io/orch8"
    }
  }
}

# Every argument can also come from the environment:
# ORCH8_URL, ORCH8_API_KEY, ORCH8_TENANT_ID.
provider "orch8" {
  endpoint  = "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
  api_key   = var.orch8_api_key
  tenant_id = "acme"
}

variable "orch8_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key sent as `x-api-key`. Defaults to `ORCH8_API_KEY`. `orch8_api_key` requires the root (admin) key.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Orch8 engine, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8080`. `/api/v1` is appended automatically. Defaults to `ORCH8_URL`, then `http://127.0.0.1:8080`.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant sent as `x-tenant-id` and used as the default `tenant_id` of resources. Defaults to `ORCH8_TENANT_ID`.
